heroSummary: Mesa Public Schools starts the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, July 26, 2028. Fall Break runs October 2–6, Winter Break runs December 25–January 5, Spring Break runs March 5–16, and the last day of school and graduation date on the calendar is Thursday, May 24, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Mesa Public Schools start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Mesa Public Schools starts the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, July 26, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Mesa Public Schools in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break is shown as March 5–16, 2029, on the reviewed MPS calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the MPS 2028–29 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed Mesa Public Schools calendar lists 180 total student days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later MPS revisions.
